name: SDN Public Query Flow
description: Sandboxed public query flow (gateway loop G.5, mount /api/v1/query). A $HTQ HttpRequest enters on the http-request trigger, foundation/http-route route_public_query parses it (POST = raw SELECT body {sql,params,format,limit,sort,profile,epoch,source} or bare SQL text; GET/HEAD = the queryable-surface listing), hostcap/flatsql-query sandbox_query composes the effective SQL IN-WASM (validated sort/limit wrapping, or a named epoch profile nearest|as_of|forward over the unified OMM view with default epoch=now) and issues the policy-mediated READ-ONLY storage.query_sandboxed hostcall. The ENGINE enforces the sandbox in-wasm: a SQLite authorizer restricted to the record tables / per-source shadow tables / unified views (control tables and sqlite_* are invisible), single-statement SELECT-only validation, a statement timeout, and row/byte caps that REJECT oversized results (host config gateway.query; defaults 5 s / 200K rows / 128 MiB). flatbuffer path: all-BLOB projections (e.g. SELECT _data ...) stream as aligned size-prefixed frames via a host body reference; projections answer 406. json path: full-record streams ride through foundation/omm-json (bare-array, schema-exact keys per hard rule json-schema-capitalization-rule); tabular projections are engine-assembled bare-array JSON whose keys are the SQL column names verbatim. Sandbox rejections map to honest statuses: validation 400, projection-as-flatbuffer 406, timeout/row-cap/byte-cap 422 (+machine-readable code in the body). foundation/http-respond assembles the final $HTR envelope (200/304/4xx/5xx) delivered to the host-model egress sink. Bridge linkage: the only host crossings are the declared storage_query hostcalls (and clock.now for default profile epochs).

triggers.description: One $HTQ HttpRequest envelope per invocation, pumped by the host at the flow ingress.

api.tagDescription: Sandboxed public raw SELECT over this node's FlatSQL engine (gateway loop G.5). Anonymous by design: abuse control is the in-engine sandbox (read-only authorizer, single-statement SELECT, statement timeout, row/byte caps), not authentication. The queryable surface is the engine hot window (recent records per standard x source), discoverable via GET.

routes.description: The public query surface, enumerated live from the engine (never hand-maintained): every readable relation (unified views like OMM with their _source column, per-source shadow tables like "OMM@celestrak-gp") with its columns (schema-exact names plus the _data record-BLOB column) and current hot-window record count, plus the effective sandbox caps (timeout_ms, max_rows, max_bytes). Everything OUTSIDE this listing is denied by the in-engine authorizer.

200.description: Surface listing object: {"tables": [{name, kind, source?, columns, records}], "caps": {timeout_ms, max_rows, max_bytes}}. Content-derived ETag; If-None-Match honored.

routes.description: Execute ONE read-only SELECT against this node's FlatSQL engine. Body: a JSON object {"sql": "SELECT ...", "params": [{"t":"i64|f64|str|bool|null|bytes","v":...}], "format": "flatbuffer"|"json", "limit": N, "sort": "COLUMN [ASC|DESC]", "profile": "nearest"|"as_of"|"forward", "epoch": <unix seconds | RFC3339>, "source": "celestrak-gp"} or raw SQL text. sort/limit wrap the SQL (SELECT * FROM (sql) ORDER BY ... LIMIT ...); profile replaces sql with the engine's per-object epoch-profile query over the unified OMM view (default epoch = now, default limit 50000). SANDBOX (enforced in-wasm by the engine, defense-in-depth): reads restricted to the listed surface (GET this route) — control tables/sqlite_* denied; writes structurally impossible; single statement only; no PRAGMA/ATTACH/temp writes/transactions; statement timeout + row/byte caps REJECT oversized work (422). ENCODINGS: default flatbuffer requires an all-BLOB projection (typically SELECT _data ... — the frames are self-identifying size-prefixed record buffers); projections answer 406 — request format=json instead. format=json serves full-record results as the bare-array record presentation (schema-exact keys, OMM adapter) and tabular projections as an engine-assembled bare array keyed by the SQL column names verbatim. No rate limiting beyond the caps lives in the node — an operator fronts the gateway with a CDN/WAF for volumetric abuse (user decision, docs/gateway-api.md).

params.name: format
params.description: Response encoding; wins over the body format field.

profile.description: Named per-object epoch profile over the unified OMM view (instead of sql).

epoch.description: Profile epoch: unix seconds number or RFC3339 string. Default now.

source.description: Profile source partition filter (shadow-table source name).

200.description: Query result. Metadata rides in headers on BOTH encodings: X-SDN-Record-Count and a content-derived ETag (shared across encodings for the same logical stream).

application/vnd.sdn.flatbuffers.stream.description: Aligned size-prefixed FlatBuffer frames — the BLOB cells of the projection in row order (self-identifying record buffers, e.g. $OMM for SELECT _data FROM OMM ...).

application/json.description: Bare top-level array: full-record results use the record presentation (schema-exact keys: NORAD_CAT_ID, MEAN_MOTION, ...); tabular projections use the SQL column names verbatim (BLOB cells base64).

304.description: Not modified (If-None-Match matched the result ETag).

400.description: Rejected by the sandbox or invalid request: non-SELECT / multi-statement / PRAGMA / ATTACH / write attempt / read outside the public surface / bad SQL / bad params / invalid sort or profile. Body: {"error", "code"}.

406.description: format=flatbuffer requested for a projection with non-BLOB cells — the raw stream is only defined for record-BLOB projections; request format=json. Body: {"error", "code": "not-a-record-stream"}.

422.description: Query exceeds this node's resource caps: statement timeout, row cap, or byte cap (bounded time is the contract — runaway/cartesian queries land here). Body: {"error", "code": "timeout"|"row-cap"|"byte-cap"}.
